sources.title: Government of the Republic of Palau

capital.evidence_quote: Ngerulmud in Melekeok State is the national capital; Koror is the commercial hub

currency.evidence_quote: The United States Dollar (USD) is the official currency of the Republic of Palau

timezone.evidence_quote: Palau operates on Palau Time UTC+9 year-round without daylight saving adjustments

voltage.evidence_quote: Standard residential supply voltage across Palau is 120V 60 Hz

frequency_hz.evidence_quote: National power network operates at 60 Hz

plug_types.evidence_quote: North American standard Type A and Type B plugs with two flat parallel pins are universal

police.evidence_quote: Dial 911 for emergency police assistance throughout Palau

sources.title: Belau National Hospital Emergency Medical Services

ambulance.evidence_quote: Call 911 or +680 488-2555 for Belau National Hospital ambulance dispatch

sources.title: Bureau of Public Safety Fire & Rescue

fire.evidence_quote: Dial 911 for fire and rescue emergency operations

general.evidence_quote: 911 is the central emergency operations number in Palau

tourist_police.evidence_quote: Palau Visitors Authority headquarters in Koror provides visitor liaison at +680 488-2793

advisory_headline.tr: Palau dünyanın en bozulmamış ve güvenli deniz eko-turizm destinasyonlarındandır; standart seyahat önlemleri yeterlidir.
advisory_headline.en: Palau is exceptionally safe and pristine; exercise normal precautions and adhere to environmental conservation rules.
advisory_headline.de: Palau ist ein unberührtes und sicheres Ökotourismus-Paradies; normale Vorsichtsmaßnahmen genügen.
advisory_headline.ru: Палау — один из самых безопасных и чистых морских заповедников планеты; соблюдайте правила охраны природы.
advisory_headline.es: Palaos es un santuario marino sumamente seguro y prístino; aplican precauciones normales.

mobile_down_mbps.evidence_quote: Median mobile broadband download speeds in Palau reach approximately 32.0 Mbps via subsea fiber cable

fixed_down_mbps.evidence_quote: Median fixed broadband download speeds in Koror measure 58.0 Mbps

esim_sim_notes.value: PNCC (Palau National Communications Corporation) provides 4G prepaid SIMs at Roman Tmetuchl International Airport (ROR). All international visitors must sign the 'Palau Pledge' stamped inside their passport committing to environmental stewardship.
esim_sim_notes.evidence_quote: Signing the environmental Palau Pledge is mandatory upon passport control entry

religion.value: Christianity (approx. 74%, predominantly Roman Catholic and Evangelical Protestant) alongside indigenous Modekngei faith

sources.title: Office of Planning and Statistics Palau

religion.evidence_quote: Christianity coexists with Modekngei, a syncretic indigenous Palauan monotheistic faith

festivals.value: Constitution Day (July 9), Independence Day (October 1), Belau National Games, Olechotel Belau Fair in Koror
festivals.evidence_quote: Olechotel Belau Fair celebrates authentic Palauan canoe building, traditional weaving, and chant performances

legal_cultural_warnings.value: Strict environmental laws: sunscreens containing oxybenzone, octinoxate, or parabens are illegal in Palau and will be confiscated at airport customs ($1,000 fine for importation/sale). Touching stingless jellyfish in Jellyfish Lake or harvesting marine life in Rock Islands is forbidden.
legal_cultural_warnings.evidence_quote: It is illegal to enter Palau with reef-toxic sunscreens under the Responsible Tourism Education Act

tipping.value: Tipping is not traditional in Palauan culture, but American tipping practices (10-15%) are customary in restaurants and for boat dive masters due to strong US ties.
tipping.evidence_quote: A 10-15% tip is customary in dining and dive excursion services
